structures.label: Inkor gap (Negative statement)
structures.formula: Subject + told + object + (that) + backshifted negative tense
structures.example_en: She told me that she didn't watch TV.

structures.label: Say va Tell fe'llari
structures.example_en: They said they were tired. / They told us they were tired.
structures.example_uz: Ular charchaganliklarini aytishdi. / Ular bizga charchaganliklarini aytishdi.

rules.title: Zamonni orqaga surish (Tense Backshift)
rules.text: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri nutqdagi zamonlar o'tgan zamonga qarab bir qadam orqaga suriladi. Masalan, Present Simple Past Simple'ga o'zgaradi.

examples.en: I live in Tashkent. -> He said he lived in Tashkent.
examples.uz: Men Toshkentda yashayman. -> U Toshkentda yashashini aytdi.

examples.en: I am eating. -> She said she was eating.
examples.uz: Men ovqat seryapman. -> U ovqat yeyayotganini aytdi.

rules.title: Say va Tell ishlatish farqi
rules.text: 'Say' fe'lidan keyin shaxs (object) kelmaydi, 'tell' fe'lidan keyin esa doim kimgadir aytilgani ko'rsatiladi (told me, told him).

examples.en: He told me he was happy.

rules.title: Olmonshakllar va vaqt so'zlarining o'zgarishi
rules.text: Gapiruvchiga qarab olmoshlar o'zgaradi. Shuningdek, vaqt so'zlari ham o'tmish nuqtai nazaridan moslashadi.

examples.en: I will go tomorrow. -> She said she would go the next day.
examples.uz: Men ertaga boraman. -> U ertasi kuni borishini aytdi.

examples.en: We met yesterday. -> They said they had met the day before.
examples.uz: Biz kecha uchrashdik. -> Ular bir kun oldin uchrashganlarini aytishdi.

mistakes.wrong: He said me that he was tired.
mistakes.right: He told me that he was tired.
mistakes.why: 'Say' fe'lidan keyin 'me' kabi shaxs qo'shib ishlatilmaydi, buning uchun 'tell' ishlatish kerak.
Ko'chirma gapda zamon bitta orqaga (Past Simple'ga) surilishi shart.

mistakes.wrong: Aziz told that he liked apples.
mistakes.right: Aziz said that he liked apples. (yoki Aziz told me that...)
mistakes.why: 'Tell' fe'lidan keyin albatta kishi olmoshi yoki ismi bo'lishi kerak.

mistakes.wrong: He said he will come tomorrow.
mistakes.right: He said he would come the next day.
mistakes.why: 'Will' so'zi 'would'ga, 'tomorrow' esa 'the next day'ga o'zgarishi kerak.
